Field or value: Read/write index. Oak's BIOS and NT driver read it, keep the byte, and write it back to restore the index they found (BIOS file offset $1BF0, NT OAK.SYS $2D50-$2DF1). Oak's NT driver finds the chip by writing $11 and checking that bits 4-0 read back $11
Source: Oak BIOS TEv1.02; NT driver; third-party OAK.TXT ("bit 0-7 Index", 83/87)

Field or value: Reads 1 on the OTI-087X. Oak's DOS installers name an 087-family chip (087B, 087D, 087X, 089) only when it reads 1 (INSTALL.EXE file offset $2B8B)
Source: Oak 87X DOS kit and 87B DOS kit; Programmer's Guide, 1994 section 25.4 and the third-party XFree86 driver also take 1 as an OTI-087
Oak BIOS TEv1.02 and TBv1.01B; third-party OAK.TXT

Bits 7-4 revision: 0 = 087B, 1 = 087D, 2 = 087X, 3 = 089. The OTI-087X reads $2x. Oak's DOS installers branch on these four values and title themselves "087B", "087D", "087X" or "089 Driver Install" (INSTALL.EXE file offsets $2BB1-$2C02, titles $80E7-$8146)
Source: Oak 87X DOS kit and 87B DOS kit

Field or value: Bits 2-0 test mode: 000 "Test CRTC", 010 "Test waveform RAM", 101 "Scan Test Attribute Controller"; 001, 011, 100, 110 and 111 reserved. Oak describes no procedure, output or read-back for 000 and 010, and no other source found does (every OTI-087 databook copy found, VGA Museum's two downloads included, is the same scan and lacks printed pp31-32)

Mode 101: in text mode the font data and the attribute data come from system data bits 15-8 and 7-0 instead of video memory; in graphics mode the pixel data comes from bits 15-8. On this card SD8-SD15 are open and SD0-SD7 are the Z180 data bus, so the font and pixel data come from unconnected pins

Bit 4: flush the write cache immediately after each write. Oak's BIOS writes $10 with bit 7 = 0 (TEv1.02 file offset $1E0E; again $00 then $10 at $1E20 and $1E28 when ext $07 bit 2 is 0), and so do Oak's OS/2 mode tables
Bit 5 VSYNC test: "This bit will cause the Vsync to toggle when it is changed from 1 to 0 or from 0 to 1"
Bit 6 I/O write test: an I/O write command is not clocked by MCLK. Must be 0 in normal operation
Bit 7: "Enable global test modes". Must be 0 in normal operation. Default $00
